-An absolute blast with friends—co-op at its finest!
-The community is great, but solo play can be tough if you’re not used to managing everything alone.
-The progression system is satisfying, with lots of customization for your dwarf and weapons.
-Some missions can feel repetitive after a while, but updates keep the game fresh.
-No microtransactions, just a solid game made by devs who care.

If you love teamwork, chaos, and space mining, this game is a must-have. Rock and Stone!

[h1][b]"Deep Rock Galactic"[/b] – a game where you and your three drunk dwarf buddies break into alien bug nests to steal shiny rocks while yelling “ROCK AND STONE!” at the top of your lungs.[/h1]

You are a dwarf. You drink, you dig, you fight off insect swarms that have too many legs and not enough patience for your nonsense.  

Your workplace is a planet that actively hates you. The floor collapses under you, the walls start spitting acid, and the ceiling caves in exactly when you thought you were safe. But the real horror isn’t the bugs. [b]The real horror is when the Driller “makes an exit,” and you’re now trapped in a hole so deep even his IQ can’t find a way out.[/b]

[h2]The four classes: [/h2]
- [b]Gunner[/b] – carries more ammo than brain cells. Shoots first, thinks never.  
- [b]Driller[/b] – makes holes in places no one asked for.  
- [b]Engineer[/b] – builds platforms that no one uses, then complains about it.  
- [b]Scout[/b] – collects minerals and shines a flashlight while his teammates are dying in a hole.  

After every mission, you return to [b]the greatest feature in gaming history – the Abyss Bar.[/b] A place where your dwarves can get so wasted they forget their tax fraud charges back on Earth. It’s a [b]true dwarf experience™[/b] – drinking irresponsibly, fighting your coworkers, and then blacking out just in time for your next shift in the death mines. There’s even a chance to drink so much you wake up on the ceiling.

10/10. A game where you hate your job, but it’s fun with friends. [h2][b]ROCK AND STONE![/b][/h2] 🤘
